headline: Last Prime Downtown Site in Taipei: Songnan Military Camp Surface Rights Floor Price NT$20.2 Billion, Bidding on November 9
summary: The National Property Administration announced 12 national land parcels for tender, with bidding expected on November 9. The Songnan Military Camp site has a royalty floor price of NT$20.2 billion and covers about 3.3 hectares.
why: Government land auctions in central Taipei set benchmarks for commercial property values and developer appetite. The National Property Administration manages Taiwan's state-owned real estate.
